item.artDescription: An engraving on this furniture illustrates <color=#D09B61FF>Kathryn 'Kat' Paluszak</color> eliminating <color=#D09B61FF>a night ave</color> by eliminating her consciousness with quick, efficient movements. <color=#D09B61FF>Kat</color> looks distressed at what she is doing. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of a group of terrorists. The work is infused with the idea of goodwill and is done in a romantic style. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Kat</color> assassinating <color=#D09B61FF>the night ave</color> on 2nd of Aprimay, 5500.
